title: Nashville Getaway Downtown Studio Deluxe
description:
Located in Nashville, 1,950 feet from Bridgestone Arena, Margaritaville Hotel Nashville features accommodations with a restaurant, private parking and a bar. Located around less than 0.6 mi from Johnny Cash Museum, the hotel with free WiFi is also a 12-minute walk away from Ryman Auditorium. The accommodations provides a 24-hour front desk and an ATM for guests.

The space
Guest rooms in the hotel are fitted with a coffee machine. All rooms will provide guests with a fridge.

Margaritaville Hotel Nashville offers a sun terrace.

Popular points of interest near the accommodations include Tootsies Orchid Lounge, Nissan Stadium and Country Music Hall of Fame and Museum. The nearest airport is Nashville International Airport, 6.2 mi from Margaritaville Hotel Nashville.

Couples in particular like the location – they rated it 9.3 for a two-person trip.

We speak your language!
